{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: NodeJS with Webpack

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x, 20.x, 22.x, 24.x, 26.x]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6

    - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-node@v6
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        cache: 'npm'

    - name: Build
      run: |
        npm run update
        npm run lib
",
  "rationale": "Two evidence-supported optimizations are applied: (1) Adding npm caching via setup-node's cache option to avoid repeated dependency downloads, supported by pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE which reports modest VM time reduction (6% free, 3.4% paid). (2) Adding concurrency to cancel superseded runs for pull requests, supported by pattern P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE which estimates VM time reduction by canceling duplicate work (1.9% free, 4.1% paid). The concurrency group uses the PR number for pull requests and the commit SHA for pushes, ensuring cancellation only within the same PR while preserving each push to main. Both changes preserve the full matrix coverage and build steps.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}

```yaml
name: NodeJS with Webpack

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x, 20.x, 22.x, 24.x, 26.x]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6

    - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-node@v6
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        cache: 'npm'

    - name: Build
      run: |
        npm run update
        npm run lib
```

Note: The concurrency group uses `github.event.pull_request.number` for PRs, and `github.sha` for pushes. This ensures each push gets a unique group (so they don't cancel each other), while PRs share the same group per PR number, so new pushes to the same PR cancel previous runs. However, if there are multiple pushes to the same branch (main) in quick succession, they would have different shas, so they won't cancel. That's fine.

Alternatively, we could use `github.ref` for pushes, but that would cause cancellation on main. Using sha is safer.
